title: Colon Cancer Free Since 2018
content: Colon Cancer Free Since 2018Radical Remission ProjectJan 4, 20241 min readCees experienced a cancer journey in 2018, where he took full responsibility for his recovery. He viewed this time as an opportunity for development and learned that there is a lot that we can do to heal ourselves. Though it can be difficult, he believes we can each make choices that influence our well-being in a positive way. Cees understands that change can be a personal challenge during a difficult period of life. In 2019, he discovered the Radical Remission Project and ever since, he has been very passionate about sharing this approach. He believes it is his 'reason for living" to share the Radical Remission healing factors and is looking forward to making this information available in The Netherlands.Listen to Cees's story and others like it here!577577 views00 commentsPost not marked as liked
